name: calc_max_drawdown
description:
Maximum drawdown of a value series: the largest fall from a running peak to a later value. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {max_drawdown}: percent of the peak, positive, 4 decimals.
Inputs (* required): portfolio_values* (array of positive numbers in time order, e.g. prices or NAVs).
For risk-adjusted return use calc_sharpe_ratio or calc_sortino_ratio.
Example: {"portfolio_values": [100, 110, 95, 120, 90, 130]}

portfolio_values.description: Positive values (prices or NAVs) in time order
